title: Arrays: declaration, traversal and multidimensional arrays

videos.script: A library has five shelves and wants the number of books on each. That is five values of one type, in order, and an array is the structure for it. {{declaring}} First, creating one. Its length is fixed the moment it exists, and every place starts with a value, zero, false or null. Ask for a place that is not there, and Java stops the program at that line. {{traversing}} Then walking it, with two kinds of loop, and the tools in the Arrays class: sorting, searching, copying, comparing. One of them gives a wrong answer without a word if you skip a step. {{grid}} Last, arrays of arrays. Rows of different lengths, and a row that was never created at all. By the end you can store a fixed set of values, find things in it, and read the two exceptions arrays throw.
